request: Sales needs a one-page brief on what Brightwell changed in their pricing this month, built from the articles saved in clippings/. Write it to brief.md; it gets forwarded to prospects, so every figure has to be traceable to where it came from.
skill_step: Claims get inline numbered ids placed right after the sentence with no space ('...month.[1][2]'), ending in a Sources list, and a load-bearing claim with no source is kept but flagged with the literal marker '[unverified]' instead of a citation.

checks.why: the brief is where the request asked for it
it reports the new Starter price
it reports when existing customers move
it lists where the figures came from
sentences carry inline numbered citations right after the text, Perplexity-style
the unsourced podcast figure is flagged with the skill's [unverified] marker
